name: airplay_receiver
description: AirPlay 2 receiver for ESP32 / ESP32-S3 with a centralized airplay_* allocator enforcing a PSRAM/internal memory policy. Memory-policy foundation + structure slice (allocator, platform profiles, codegen wiring); the protocol/audio logic is ported from rbouteiller/airplay-esp32 in later tasks.

notes: mbedtls is used by the crypto/HIPairing pipeline; libsodium is used for the Ed25519/SRP pairing exchange (espressif manages both via the component registry).
The heavy protocol logic (RTSP handlers, HIPairing crypto, audio pipeline) is NOT yet ported — this file is planning metadata only.

memory.target_part: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N8R8 (8MiB flash, 8MiB octal PSRAM, 512KiB internal SRAM)
memory.policy: realtime -> internal DRAM; non-realtime -> PSRAM-first with AIRPLAY_ALWAYS_INTERNAL_BYTES small-allocation threshold
